correctedCritiques.con-defeasible-explanatory-default: Strongest feature: The reply precisely distinguishes a defeasible explanatory presumption from an exceptionless metaphysical requirement, allowing theoretical considerations to warrant principled departures from experiential regularities. Principal limitation: It establishes warranted exceptions more convincingly than it supplies concrete, independently supported evidence identifying foundational limits as the relevant exception here. Live burden: The con case must specify when explanatory pressure is overridden, demonstrate why its proposed stopping point possesses exceptional status, and avoid treating the availability of a compatible theory as automatically defeating the default. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exact conceptual diagnosis, responsiveness to both central explanatory targets, and restrained calibration, with limited deduction because the supporting discussion remains indirect and vindicates no particular unexplained foundation.
correctedCritiques.con-rival-causal-principle-symmetry: Strongest feature: The symmetry challenge exposes an undercutting problem by arguing that parallel inductive, abductive, intuitive, and relevant-difference considerations can support rival causal principles conflicting with traditional theism. Principal limitation: Its force depends upon genuine evidential parity, but the move does not demonstrate that the material-causal rival and limits principle share comparable cases, modal scope, domain conditions, or explanatory motivation. Live burden: The con case must defend the parallel enough that distinctions involving causal type, domain, or background evidence cannot provide an inexpensive symmetry breaker. Locked score: The very strong band reflects lucid formulation, relevance, conditional calibration, and substantial pressure on the pro methodology, while leaving unresolved whether the alternative principle is genuinely co-supported rather than analogically suggestive.
